name: Call of Fire

angles.text: As a shaman, you face a spiritual trial that carries you from stone’s endurance to fire’s fierce, destructive power.
As an Alliance shaman, you follow your elders’ guidance in the mountains of Dun Morogh to awaken communion with the elements of fire.
As a dwarf, you face this trial high above South Gate Outpost in Dun Morogh, where your discipline is tested against flame’s burning hunger.

faq.answer: Bruegs Kindleborn mentors shamans in a mountain cave high above South Gate Outpost in Dun Morogh. Elders send initiates to him, and he judges whether they have the maturity and discipline to receive the fire sapta.

A sapta is an elemental draught or preparation that lets a shaman commune with spirits of that element. The sapta of fire grants communion with flame and its raw power, and calls for mental focus and prior grounding in stone.
faq.q: What is the sapta of fire?

aliases: where is call of fire turn in
faq.answer: Bruegs Kindleborn lives far east in the snowy mountains of Dun Morogh, sheltered in a cave overlooking South Gate Outpost.
Call of Fire brings shamans who have shown patience and mastered earth before the chaotic power of destruction. Bruegs Kindleborn watches over their trial.
faq.q: What is the purpose of the Call of Fire?

faq.answer: Earth teaches steadfast patience, stability, and control. Without stone’s grounding, a shaman risks being overwhelmed by fire’s volatile hunger and destructive passions.
faq.q: Why must a shaman learn the lessons of stone before fire?

faq.answer: Before this rite, an initiate has shown patience and grounding in earth through earlier trials. The elder sends a student to Bruegs Kindleborn only when their discipline is proven solid.
faq.q: What prerequisites are required before undertaking the Call of Fire?

sections.body: After proving patience and grounding through earth, shamans face a more volatile force: the fire elemental spirit. Stone holds steady, but fire promises chaos, ruin, and fierce energy. So an elder sends the initiate across Dun Morogh’s snow-laden peaks to seek guidance before trying to harness its wild heat.
sections.title: The Burning Trial

sections.body: Bruegs Kindleborn keeps watch in a secluded cave high in the mountains above South Gate Outpost. When an initiate arrives with an elder’s recommendation, Bruegs prepares them for the sapta of fire. He warns that flame’s hunger to burn and consume is easily stirred. To master it, a shaman must know when to hold back.
sections.title: The Recluse of the Peaks

summary: In Dun Morogh, an elder sends shaman initiates to Bruegs Kindleborn to test their readiness for the fire sapta. They have already learned patience and grounding through earth.
